answer: A concrete defense is stake-gated admission at a single public wharf. Every new identity must lock capital that remains in a haven until a probation of attested work is finished; rewards vest only then. If the agent exits early or fails quorum, the bond is burned and the slash is published as a plume of failed identities. A sybil attacker therefore pays a fresh lock and a waiting cost for every fake, so mass registration is a balance-sheet expense rather than a free name grab.
